svg.title: Присед в широкой стойке с гирей — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Wide-stance sumo goblet squat holding one kettlebell against the sternum by its handle with both hands. Front oblique view to show feet much wider than shoulders and toes angled outward. START upright with knees nearly straight. FINISH hips lower between thighs until near knee height, knees bend out in direction of toes, feet and heels remain planted and same width. Keep same single recognizable kettlebell at chest in both poses. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
